title.zh-CN: 反复黑便与面色苍白八年
title.en: Recurrent melaena and pallor over eight years

summary.zh-CN: 多年消化道出血多次常规检查未能定位，本次伴重度贫血，需要把定位证据与病理定性区分。
summary.en: Years of gastrointestinal bleeding remain unlocalised after conventional tests, now with severe anaemia.

text.zh-CN: Hb 28 g/L，红细胞1.81×10^12/L，血小板363×10^9/L；大便隐血++，凝血正常，骨髓呈缺铁表现。
text.en: Haemoglobin 28 g/L, red cells 1.81×10^12/L and platelets 363×10^9/L; stool occult blood ++, normal coagulation and an iron-deficiency marrow pattern.

text.zh-CN: 异位胃黏膜扫描阴性；标记红细胞显像见较固定放射性浓集。CT见空肠约2.0×3.5 cm肿块，门静脉期明显强化并有点状钙化。
text.en: Ectopic gastric mucosa imaging was negative; labelled-red-cell imaging showed a relatively fixed focus. CT found a roughly 2.0×3.5 cm jejunal mass with marked portal-venous enhancement and punctate calcification.

text.zh-CN: 屈氏韧带远侧约5 cm见5×3×3 cm暗红结节状肿物；切除病理为海绵状血管瘤伴出血钙化。
text.en: A 5×3×3 cm dark-red nodular mass lay about 5 cm distal to the ligament of Treitz; resection showed cavernous haemangioma with haemorrhage and calcification.

prompt.zh-CN: 多次常规检查阴性后应怎样解释本次定位？
prompt.en: How should localisation be interpreted after negative conventional investigations?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 小肠病灶可在既往常规内镜覆盖外，现有定位须结合严重失血处理
text.en: A small-bowel lesion may lie beyond previous routine endoscopy and localisation must be paired with severe-bleeding care

feedback.zh-CN: 阴性检查受覆盖和时机影响；Hb 28 g/L不能被忽略。
feedback.en: Negative tests depend on reach and timing; haemoglobin 28 g/L cannot be ignored.

text.zh-CN: 胃肠镜阴性已经排除消化道来源
text.en: Negative routine endoscopy excludes a gastrointestinal source

feedback.en: The small bowel remains insufficiently assessed.

text.zh-CN: 核素任意阳性都证明梅克尔憩室
text.en: Any positive nuclear focus proves Meckel diverticulum

feedback.zh-CN: 标记红细胞与异位胃黏膜显像目的不同。
feedback.en: Labelled-red-cell and ectopic-mucosa studies answer different questions.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 手术病理将定位病灶定性为出血性海绵状血管瘤
text.en: Surgical pathology classifies the localised lesion as a bleeding cavernous haemangioma

feedback.zh-CN: 强化及钙化提供线索，组织是本例定性证据。
feedback.en: Enhancement and calcification were clues; tissue provides classification in this case.

text.zh-CN: 单例证明CT对所有出血定位准确率100%
text.en: This case proves CT is 100% accurate for all bleeding

feedback.zh-CN: 单例不能支持普遍准确率。
feedback.en: A single case cannot establish universal accuracy.

text.zh-CN: 缺铁骨髓证明出血来自骨髓
text.en: Iron-deficiency marrow means bleeding originates in marrow

feedback.zh-CN: 缺铁反映长期失血后果，不是肠道定位替代。
feedback.en: Iron deficiency reflects chronic blood loss rather than its intestinal location.

prompt.zh-CN: 怎样表述安全的现代计划？
prompt.en: How should a safe modern plan be framed?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 先评估和纠正严重失血风险，再由专科按病灶范围决定定位与处理
text.en: Assess and stabilise severe blood-loss risk, then plan lesion-directed evaluation and treatment with specialists

feedback.zh-CN: 不能让进一步定位延误重度贫血支持；儿童方法需个体化。
feedback.en: Further localisation must not delay severe-anaemia support; paediatric methods require individualisation.

text.zh-CN: 继续旧止血药即可，不必关注Hb
text.en: Continue old remedies without addressing haemoglobin

feedback.zh-CN: 长期效果差且贫血极重，不能维持同样策略。
feedback.en: Prior benefit was poor and anaemia is extreme.

text.zh-CN: 照搬旧文建议给所有弥漫病变放疗
text.en: Apply historical radiotherapy advice to every diffuse lesion

feedback.zh-CN: 旧讨论不是当前儿童血管异常治疗规范。
feedback.en: Historical discussion is not a current paediatric vascular-anomaly protocol.

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 说明常规内镜阴性不代表全小肠正常。；承认缺少长期复发、现代小肠内镜及血管异常分类复核。，用复述确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain that Negative routine endoscopy does not establish a normal entire small bowel.; acknowledge Long-term recurrence, modern enteroscopy and vascular-anomaly classification review are unavailable. and check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 长期小肠出血最终由空肠海绵状血管瘤解释。
conclusion.en: A jejunal cavernous haemangioma explained the chronic small-bowel bleeding.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 常规内镜阴性不代表全小肠正常。
keyReasoning.en: Negative routine endoscopy does not establish a normal entire small bowel.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 不同核素检查不能互换解释。
keyReasoning.en: Different nuclear studies are not interchangeable.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 病理定性与影像定位互补。

teachingPoints.en: Recognise the severity of very low haemoglobin.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 不引用旧文100%定位为普遍事实。
teachingPoints.en: Do not generalise historical claims of perfect localisation.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 治疗选择需基于病灶和儿童情境。
teachingPoints.en: Treatment depends on lesion extent and paediatric context.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

unknowns.zh-CN: 缺少长期复发、现代小肠内镜及血管异常分类复核。
unknowns.en: Long-term recurrence, modern enteroscopy and vascular-anomaly classification review are unavailable.
